cards.name: Druid, Serara
cards.text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.

cards.name: Akatsuki
cards.text:
【AUTO】 [Put a marker from underneath this card into your waiting room] When this card attacks, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's level 0 or lower characters in the center stage, and put it into your opponent's waiting room. 

【ACT】 [【REST】 this card] If there are no markers underneath this card, put the top card of your deck underneath this card as a marker.

cards.name: Marielle Using Telepathy
cards.text: 【AUTO】 [(2)] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a character in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.

cards.name: Embarassed Akatsuki
cards.text: 【CONT】 If the number of other 《Weapon》 or 《Magic》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +1500 power.

cards.name: Crescent Moon Alliance Accountant, Henrietta
cards.text: 【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 3000, Level 2 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +3000 power until end of turn)

cards.name: Crescent Moon Alliance Representative, Marielle
cards.text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +1000 power. 

【ACT】 [(1)] Choose one of your 《Weapon》 characters, and that character gets +1500 power until end of turn.

cards.name: Assassination
cards.text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.

cards.name: Chef, Nyan-ta
cards.text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top or the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Swashbuckler, Nyan-ta
cards.text: 【AUTO】 When a card named "Sophisticated Cooperation" is placed on your climax area, if you have another character with "Shiroe(シロエ)" in its card name, this card gets +4000 power until end of turn.

cards.name: Composed Expression, Shiroe
cards.text: 【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】.)

cards.name: Shiroe
cards.text: 【AUTO】 [Put the top card of your deck into your clock] When this card's battle opponent becomes 【REVERSE】, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw a card.

cards.name: Naotsugu
cards.text: 【ACT】 [【REST】 one of your 《Magic》 characters] This card gets +1000 power until end of turn.

cards.name: Enchanter, Shiroe
cards.text:
【CONT】 If the number of cards in your hand is five or more, this card gets +1500 power and the following ability. "【CONT】 During this card's battle, your opponent cannot play "Backup" from hand." 

【AUTO】 When this card is frontal attacked, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room.

cards.name: Enchanter's Support
cards.text: Choose one of your opponent's level 3 or lower characters. That character cannot 【STAND】 during your opponent's next stand phase. Choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.

cards.name: Sophisticated Cooperation
cards.text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.

cards.name: First Spoils of Victory
cards.text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from your hand, choose up to one blue card in your waiting room, put it into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.
